answer: Cross-Modal Timing Attestation. Each agent identity must answer a hardware challenge at an inlet that measures two independent physical channels (power draw and thermal rise) under a randomized load pattern. A valid identity shows correlated responses at a vertex of the timing trace, verified against a shared clock at the summit of the challenge round. An operator with one machine cannot fake independent power and heat signatures for thousands of identities; each fake needs its own physical substrate. Per-identity cost becomes a real device.
